text:
maria: FYI: after last night's OOB firmware roll (03:10Z) a eu-west rack canary hit repeated PCIe lane retrains and subsequent NVMe resets causing kubelet evictions. Not yet global but reprod on local canary.

ops-ethan: Confirmed: r21-03 showed `PCIe: Link retrain (slot 1)` x6 in 2m and `/var/log/kern.log` shows NVMe controller reset. Starting revert on r21-03 now.

sre-robin: Quick triage: the BMC update flipped the secure-boot enforcement bit on a subset of devices during image apply; that caused a reinitialization sequence that triggers a PCIe retrain on some boards.

infra-oncall: Pausing rollout to remaining eu-west and eu-central racks. deploy-bot: mark rollout paused.

deploy-bot: rollout "oob-fw-2026-03-21" status: PAUSED by infra-oncall at 04:05Z.

aisha: Mitigation plan: 1) pause global; 2) revert affected racks to previous signed BMC image; 3) run 45m storage+GPU canary; 4) add preflight checks (BMC time, AER counters) to pipeline.

maria: Please also hold autoscaler scale-in for inference pools in eu-west to avoid churn. We should track cost impact.

finance-liz: Noted. Preliminary estimate: 80-140 GPU-hours if we hold canaries for 24h. Ive pinged budget owners.

ops-ethan: Revert command used:
```
ssh jump-rack
sudo /usr/local/bin/bmc-flash --image s3://fw-repo/bmc-2026-02-09-signed.bin --rack r21-03 --force-reboot
sleep 30; bmc-health --rack r21-03 --format short
```

ops-ethan: After revert, initial logs show no further PCIe retrain events in the 10m window. Running `fio` + 10m GPU burn now.

sre-robin: After revert passes, we'll require increased observation time (60m) and enable full PCIe/slot AER telemetry for the next canary. Also gating criteria: zero NVMe controller resets and stable GPU allocations for 30m.

maria: Postmortem owners: jonathan + aisha. Immediate actions list: pause rollout (done), revert r21-03 (in progress), autoscaler hold (done), finance notified (done). I'll post an incident update to #incidents in 15m. :thumbsup:

infra-oncall: Adding a pre-deploy job to validate BMC NTP sync (`bmcctl ntp-status`) and check AER counters before allowing rack-level apply.

ops-ethan: Will follow up with hardware-ops if any board shows persistent lane retrain after full power-cycle.

maria: Thanks team. Keep updates short and post any customer-facing impact ASAP.
